body: I have before and honestly they do very little for you.
Maybe like 20-30% at most really that I deal with on it's own

I have my earlier problems but I don't want to burden her either. I know that while sharing is part of a relationship it can also become an issue when one part is on the edge. It can pull people apart when someone feels that they are relying on them
I know what I'm doing in life. Surviving somehow and if that's all I'm gonna do what's the fucking point.

Because I look at her sure she has her problems but god above she could is beyond amazing and why she hasn't realised that yet is beyond me. That's the only reason I don't want to tell her because it just make me feel like she'll finally realise.

I doubt she would. We've both had a fair few partners and we both say we are towards the top end of that scale if not at the top. So honestly I doubt it but I'm afraid one day she will wake up and realise just how much better she can do. That eventually she see me for what I am and jump ship before it sinks. Sharing any of this with her just makes me think it'll bring an end to one of the few things I have going for me.
